is: The live port implementations: a directory design source, a shell gate, the GitHub board and forge through gh, a jj VCS, a process runner and the system shell.
conventions: Backends are reached by shelling out (gh, jj, sh -c), never through a client library
Each CLI has one door: every gh call goes through GhCommand (github/command.rs), every jj call through jj/command.rs; a failed call becomes PortError::Backend carrying stderr
Values substituted into a shell template are single-quoted

fs.name: design.rs
fs.role: DirDesign: Markdown pages beside an index, subfolders included, for repo-dir and git-sibling

fs.name: gate.rs
fs.role: ShellGate: [gate] lines by sh -c, output logged under .zaf/runs/

fs.name: github/
fs.role: board on issues, forge on PRs, GhCommand, comment notes, gh JSON rows

fs.name: jj.rs
fs.role: JjVcs: a slice is a jj workspace plus a same-named bookmark

fs.name: runner.rs
fs.role: ProcessRunner: a role run as a [runners.<name>] command template

fs.name: shell.rs
fs.role: SystemShell: sh -c in its own process group, killed past a time bound

notes: Claims and heartbeats are plain issue comments; reports and rulings open with a hidden HTML marker (github/notes.rs)
github/tests.rs puts zaf/tests/fixtures/gh first on PATH; jj/tests.rs drives a real jj
One adapter per kind today: board github-issues, forge github, vcs jj, design repo-dir or git-sibling; a git Vcs adapter is a named later use case
The gate's run folder carries a .gitignore of `*`, so gate logs never show as uncommitted work
